body:
KD: I dont believe in judging by KD.Pros: I can Ninja and No Shift Ninja, Quite good at Melee and also decent with bow. I can also defend if the game is unorganised and we need a defender. I can also speak French. I have good Scrimmage experience. I know most maps. Good Wool Capper. Decent at Tactics
Cons: Sometimes clumsy, Most of the time I fail the breezily, I sometimes get a bit hot headed, but I always apologise after, sometimes get frustrated/annoyed.
